verdict.rationale: Fastmail has dedicated first-party help articles for both parts of the story: 'Scheduled Send' (send later) and 'Undo send' (retract within a grace window). The evidence pack contains only the article titles, so the depth of each feature is not shown. Missing for 10: details of scheduling options (time picker, editing or cancelling scheduled messages), the length and configurability of the undo-send grace window, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
